concerns.text: The plan estimates diffusion lengths via an empirical relation that maps the *composite spatial ordering metric* (itself derived from the same autocorrelation lengths) to diffusion length (see FR‑009 description). Using this derived diffusion length as an additional predictor for device performance creates a predictor that is not independent of the spatial metrics already being correlated with performance, leading to a circular/tautological validation when the same data inform both predictor and outcome.
